integrity: The q-moment cutoffs and sharpness are analytic; 509 finite rational/symbolic checks verify algebra and examples only. No independent verification or comprehensive historical-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for a nonzero symmetric quadratic integrand under iid standard Gaussian input, unregularized same-sample intercept-plus-linear OLS and \(n\ge d+1\). One-dimensional exception separately stated. It does not apply to independent pilot fitting, regularization, bounded inputs or other integrands.
title: A sharp dimension-dependent moment cutoff for Gaussian regression control variates
